name: The Consulate
description: The Consulate is the governing body of Kaladesh, which controlled aether and was ruled by Tezzeret until it was overthrown and Kaladesh became Avishkar.

summary.text: The Consulate is the governing body of Kaladesh, which controlled aether and was ruled by Tezzeret until it was overthrown and Kaladesh became Avishkar.

bio.text: It developed mass production and distribution of refined aether, spurring the Great Aether Boom, and announced the Inventors' Fair.
The renegades came to defy it, believing it concealed information and oppressed the public, and it arrested their leader Pia Nalaar.
Under Tezzeret as Grand Consul, with Dovin Baan as inspector, it confiscated all of the Fair's inventions, and its secret headquarters was the Dhund.
Yahenni and Gonti became its enemies, and the Gatewatch and renegades fought its soldiers and automata at the Spire.
The Consulate was then reformed, emptying and demolishing the Dhund and welcoming Pia Nalaar as a Consul of Allocation.
Later, the Consulate was overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution, and Kaladesh was reborn as Avishkar.

status.text: As of the latest story it is no longer in power, having been overthrown in a nearly bloodless revolution, and it is called Avishkar's former governing body.

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul face qualifiers within a week, hoping for the Consulate's support.
timeline.quote: The Inventors' Fair qualifiers were less than a week away.

timeline.summary: Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer.
timeline.quote: tossing her drink into the vedalken's face

timeline.summary: When the soldier pulls out restraints, Chandra punches him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist arced around and collided with his jawbone in one fluid motion.

timeline.summary: Chased by Consulate guards, Chandra refuses Liliana's lethal option and blocks the alley with a wall of fire.
timeline.quote: spreading into a wall of fire that spanned the alley's width

timeline.summary: The train stops amid an aether disruption that Chandra attributes to the renegade.
timeline.quote: A disruption. The aftermath of some kind of aerial display.

timeline.summary: Years later, Pia has rallied a contingent of inventors and citizens as the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether.
timeline.quote: Pia had rallied a growing contingent of inventors, tinkers, artists

timeline.summary: Pia rallies the renegades, listing grievances about the Consulate taking their aether, before the display.
timeline.quote: Let us be as proud, unafraid, unyielding as those who believe they can extinguish our spirits!

timeline.summary: The thopters release a pulse of aether that topples the Consulate automatons.
timeline.quote: The sudden rush of energy flooded into the identical automata, creating sparks of concentrated aether.

timeline.summary: Chandra charges the soldiers and burns a crowd of automatons.
timeline.quote: inundated a crowd of the machines with a generous bath of flames

timeline.summary: Baan orders the soldiers to isolate and contain the pyromancer with gearhulks.
timeline.quote: Isolate and contain. Gearhulks in the front line

timeline.summary: Nissa's vines topple guards moving on Chandra.
timeline.quote: Several of them toppled, feet tangled in a hissing whirl of flowered vines

timeline.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
timeline.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

timeline.summary: Soldiers manacle Pia and read out her crimes.
timeline.quote: you are hereby placed under the authority of the Consulate for the following crimes

timeline.summary: Pia kicks and bashes soldiers to draw Chandra's attention and stop her advance.
timeline.quote: You forgot assault!

timeline.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
timeline.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

timeline.summary: A Consulate prison enforcer tries to force a bathroom door to seize a wanted convict.
timeline.quote: A wanted convict is currently barricaded behind that door.

timeline.summary: A potted plant coils around the enforcer's leg and he falls dazed.
timeline.quote: The potted plant by the door is inexplicably wrapped around the enforcer's leg

timeline.summary: Nissa carries the enforcer outside.
timeline.quote: easily hoists the man over her shoulders in a fireman's carry

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds an escaped aetherborn convict dying in the bathroom with one minute left.
timeline.quote: I've got about a minute left,

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds the dead aetherborn was jailed for petty theft and is enraged at the Consulate.
timeline.quote: They shouldn't have been sent to prison in the first place.

timeline.summary: Yahenni considers hunting down the Consulate with essence draining but decides the time will come later.
timeline.quote: No. The time will come for that.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Grandmother Pashiri's building surrounded by Consulate inspectors.
timeline.quote: Grandmother's building was surrounded.

timeline.summary: Ajani sneaks into her ransacked home and knocks two inspectors' heads together.
timeline.quote: His metal-shrouded hands caught and knocked their heads together.

timeline.summary: Ajani pins the supervisor to a wall and demands to know where Grandmother Pashiri is.
timeline.quote: Where is Grandmother Pashiri?

timeline.summary: The supervisor says she is in custody, trapped as a renegade, and Ajani knocks him out, saying he no longer kills.
timeline.quote: I don't kill.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde says she came looking for Renegade Prime and fears the Consuls took them, and offers to take Ajani to a renegade safe house.
timeline.quote: I came here looking for Renegade Prime. She was overdue.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde explains the Dhund is a secret Consulate headquarters beneath Gonti's night market.
timeline.quote: The Dhund is a headquarters the Consuls built under and through Gonti's market.

timeline.summary: Following the mechanical bird, Ajani enters the Dhund and knocks out a guard.
timeline.quote: He backhanded the guard into the wall and winced at the sudden scent of blood.

timeline.summary: Ajani vaults the rail, sheds Grandmother's cloak and gauntlets and attacks the guards at the poison chamber.
timeline.quote: They unclasped and fell away.

timeline.summary: Ajani swings for a guard's throat but reads his soul and decides he is just a man.
timeline.quote: Not a Planeswalker. Not a villain.

timeline.summary: Ajani smashes the guard's chestplate without killing him and sends the other fleeing.
timeline.quote: It smashed across the guard's chestplate, scattering twisted metal shards across the marble floor.

timeline.summary: Ajani lets the guard he struck go home, repeating that he does not kill anymore.
timeline.quote: Go home to your family,

timeline.summary: The announcer declares Rashmi top prize winner of the Fair and prizewinning inventions are quietly taken by guards.
timeline.quote: An announcer was proclaiming that Rashmi had won top prize at the Fair

timeline.summary: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers seize inventions across the fairgrounds, provoking panic and anger among the inventors.
timeline.quote: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers were seizing inventions in their characteristically clumsy fashion

timeline.summary: Baan advises an enforcer how to disable a lifecraft elephant by cutting its exposed cable.
timeline.quote: All that is required is to sever the cable, and the entire automaton will collapse.

timeline.summary: Baan orders the elven lifecrafter taken into custody for the disturbance.
timeline.quote: Take the elf into custody to answer for this disturbance.

timeline.summary: Baan reaches the storage facility where scientists catalog the confiscated inventions, which he now oversees.
timeline.quote: Top scientists and inventors from every Consulate inquirium in the city had been sent here

timeline.summary: The Consulate develops mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.
timeline.quote: The Consulate developed methods for mass production and distribution of refined aether.

timeline.summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
timeline.quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

timeline.summary: The renegades come to defy the Consulate, believing it conceals information and oppresses the public.
timeline.quote: These renegades defy the Consulate as they attempt to restore the independence they believe they deserve.

timeline.summary: The Consulate announces the Inventors' Fair, to be held for a month across downtown Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: For a full month, the fairgrounds will span the whole of downtown Ghirapur, the largest city on Kaladesh.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

timeline.summary: A Consulate enforcer and an armament automaton arrest Nived for vandalism and shock him unconscious with an energy device.
timeline.quote: Nived screams, seizes, and topples to the ground.

timeline.summary: Yahenni, descending the ladder, sees a Consulate cruiser speeding toward the statue and leaps onto its hood, draining the enforcer driver to death.
timeline.quote: And I jump down.

timeline.summary: Gideon confronts Liliana for killing Consulate forces; she argues death is a tool and they had to.
timeline.quote: "We don't kill."

timeline.summary: Gideon withstands a charging Consulate charger in Bomat and shields its driver.
timeline.quote: The charger smashed into Gideon.

timeline.summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.
timeline.quote: "They're there! Stop them!"

timeline.summary: Kari and Jace use Jace's illusions to pose as a Consulate vessel and steal canisters of aether from a Consulate collecting ship.
timeline.quote: smuggling canisters of their inventory onto her ship under the approving gaze of Consulate stooges

timeline.summary: Depala dives the Dragon's Smile into the Consulate blockade, scattering the formation, and the raiders deploy.
timeline.quote: Dragon's Smile soared between the first of the Consulate ships and through the gap in the blockade.

timeline.summary: Kari fights Consulate enforcers on the deck and in flight.
timeline.quote: Kari and the dwarf tumbled to the deck of Dragon's Smile .

timeline.summary: Liliana stuns the Consulate soldiers at a barricade without killing them and enters the Spire.
timeline.quote: just enough mana to suck the breath from their lungs until their vision went black and their knees buckled

timeline.summary: The reformed Consulate empties and demolishes the Dhund, freeing hundreds of prisoners, mostly mages and renegades.
timeline.quote: Hundreds of prisoners—most of them mages and renegades who had "disappeared" long ago—were released in the space of a couple hours.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur celebrates a new Consulate leadership that includes Pia Nalaar.
timeline.quote: One that included even "Renegade Prime" herself, Pia Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Ishikari presents her improvised net machine, built in defiance of the Consulate.
timeline.quote: Crafted from whatever she could get her hands on in defiance of the Consulate and good sense alike

timeline.summary: The Consulate is overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution, and Kaladesh is reborn as Avishkar.
timeline.quote: The ruling Consulate has been overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution.

timeline.summary: The Consulate announces a month-long fair that is secretly a deception to gather and control the plane's newest technologies.
timeline.quote: In truth, the Fair was a deception

timeline.summary: The rebel Renegades thwart the Consulate's plan, clearing the way for Avishkar's new beginnings.
timeline.quote: Their plan was thwarted by a rebel group known as the Renegades

relations.note: She is a consul and judge.
relations.quote: The consul will see you now.

relations.note: Chandra calls him one of the Consulate.
He is the Consulate's Minister of Inspections.
relations.quote: the stately vedalken Minister of Inspections himself, Dovin Baan

relations.note: Yahenni says Consulate bastards are killing aetherborn faster.
relations.quote: Those Consulate bastards are just killing us faster.
Consul Kambal set the thopter down on a desk.
The Consulate had recognized his talents, which accounted for his rise to the position of senior inspector

relations.note: Senior Consulate inspector in charge of inspection at the Fair.
relations.quote: the Consulate has put him in charge of inspection at the Inventors' Fair

relations.note: Yahenni resolves to kill bad people and help the renegades.
relations.quote: I want to join the renegade cause

relations.note: Gonti calls the curfew and confiscation a curse on the city.
relations.quote: the Consulate's mandatory curfew and confiscation of our personal property is a curse on our city

relations.note: Tezzeret maintains control and leadership of the Consulate.
relations.quote: With Tezzeret still maintaining control and leadership of the Consulate
the floating mass that dominated the airspace between the spire and Weldfast
The Consulate ship sagged in the air

relations.note: Baral blames Baan for the inspectors' end.
relations.quote: "It was Baan, wasn't it?" Baral growled.

relations.note: She joins the new Consulate leadership as Consul of Allocation.
relations.quote: "... The Consul of Allocation," Chandra intoned.
now Special Grand Consul Tezzeret, endowed by the Consuls for the duration of the present crisis

relations.note: The Renegades thwarted the Consulate's plan.
relations.quote: Their plan was thwarted by a rebel group known as the Renegades

The government of Kaladesh whose inspectors hunt renegades.
The government of Kaladesh whose soldiers serve Tezzeret.

The governing body of Ghirapur which confiscated unapproved devices, cut energy access and imposed a curfew.
The government of Kaladesh, led by Tezzeret, enforcing a crackdown.
Kaladesh's governing body, which claims all that is made in the Inquirium.
Ghirapur's government under Tezzeret, which seized inventions and prioritizes its own aether supply.

The government defending the Spire with turrets and automata.
